name: savoya-quoting
description: Savoya quoting: quote-intake (client request → exact engine quote, two questions, value/elevated or a mix sourced from nearby markets, refine, handoff) and quote-document (handoff → client-facing PDF / email copy / HTML email / DOCX / XLSX through six fixed questions plus one conditional). Every price is Core's; a document that does not reconcile is not produced. Bundles the Savoya MCP connector.
